  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/glib/glib/guri.c","function":"g_uri_split_internal","line":661,"var":"p","code":"p++; continue;","note":"After a lone '%' or a truncated escape, the parser still advances as if a full %HH sequence existed, so later iterations can read past the end of the URI buffer."},
